nvitk.io.conversors._phase2volume_bg¶

Spatial polynomial background correction for PC-MRI velocity (QVTplus-style).

Fits a low-order polynomial in normalized voxel coordinates to each velocity component using voxels with low speed on the temporal mean field, evaluates the fit on the full grid, then subtracts that 3D background from the mean field and from each time frame (MATLAB-style: correct vMean and each frame).

Uses nvitk.core.backend.setup() so np follows the active NumPy or CuPy backend (see nvitk.core.backend).
